candidates.name: Florence-2-base (and -ft)

repos.note: Original Microsoft repo; config.json still uses auto_map -> trust_remote_code (modeling_florence2.py).
Fine-tuned generalist checkpoint (downstream mixture incl. VQAv2/TextVQA/VizWiz per card).
Native-transformers-format conversion (no remote code); card license MIT (license_link points to Florence-2-large LICENSE).
Contributor conversion used in transformers docs pipeline example; card tag apache-2.0 conflicts with upstream MIT -> do not use as licence source.
Transformers.js ONNX export (vision_encoder + embed_tokens + encoder_model + decoder_model_merged).

parameters.source: HF safetensors metadata (F16) microsoft/Florence-2-base; card: 0.23B; paper: 232M

license.weights: MIT (model card YAML + LICENSE file 'Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation') for both base and base-ft
license.backbones: Image encoder initialised from UniCL (microsoft/UniCL LICENSE: MIT); encoder-decoder from BART (facebookresearch/fairseq LICENSE: MIT); DaViT reference impl dingmyu/davit LICENSE: MIT
license.training_data: FLD-5B: 126M images from ImageNet-22k, Objects365, Open Images, Conceptual Captions, LAION (filtered); 5.4B annotations generated by specialist models (DINO, Grounding DINO, SAM, captioners, cloud OCR services) with filtering. Paper does not state a release or licence for FLD-5B. Source-image licences are heterogeneous -> legal review item; weights themselves MIT.

candidates.architecture: DaViT vision encoder (dim_embed [128,256,512,1024], depths [1,1,9,1]) + BART-style encoder-decoder (6 enc + 6 dec layers, d_model 768, vocab 51289 incl. 1000 <loc_*> tokens)
candidates.image_preprocessing: CLIPImageProcessor resize to 768x768 (no aspect preservation, no center crop), ImageNet mean/std, image_seq_length 577; box/polygon coordinates quantised to 1000 bins (<loc_0>..<loc_999>)

tasks.vqa: NO VQA task token in base or base-ft processor (processing_florence2.py at the audited revisions). Text without a task token is passed through unchanged by the processor, but no VQA prompt format is documented. base-ft card reports VQAv2 79.7 / TextVQA 63.6 / VizWiz 63.6 for the fine-tuned generalist, so VQA was in the -ft mixture, but the prompt is undocumented -> treat free-form/closed-answer VQA as UNSUPPORTED/UNVERIFIED.

transformers_native.evidence: raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/transformers/<tag>/src/transformers/models/florence2/modeling_florence2.py -> 404 at v4.53.0/v4.54.0/v4.55.0/v4.55.4, 200 at v4.56.0/v4.57.0/v5.0.0; PyPI transformers 4.56.0 uploaded 2025-08-29; docs credit contributor ducviet00
transformers_native.before: trust_remote_code=True with microsoft/* repo (AutoModelForCausalLM via auto_map)

onnx.note: q4/bnb4 leave embed_tokens unquantised (same 157.6 MB file); DaViT vision encoder shrinks little under 4-bit (81.3 MB q4 vs 93.8 MB int8). Third-party ONNX: jeiku/*, Heliosoph/*, happyme531/Florence-2-base-ft-ONNX-RKNN2 (not audited).

candidates.transformers_js: Florence2ForConditionalGeneration present in @huggingface/transformers 3.0.0, 3.2.0, 3.4.0, 3.5.0 and 4.3.0 (latest, 2026-09-16) - verified by string search in dist bundles
candidates.gguf_llama_cpp: NOT supported (no Florence-2 in llama.cpp docs/multimodal.md)
candidates.litert: No official/community LiteRT bundle found (HF search litert-community)
candidates.runtime_feasibility: ORT-web WASM: ONNX graphs exist and use standard ops + dynamic-quant ops; not executed in this audit. ONNX Runtime Mobile/Android: same graphs. Encoder-decoder (not decoder-only) -> not loadable by LiteRT-LM, MediaPipe LLM Inference, llama.cpp or MLC-LLM.
candidates.per_image_latency: UNMEASURED (no official or credible Android/ARM measurement found)
candidates.cancellation: Generation is a caller/Transformers.js token loop over decoder_model_merged -> stop between tokens (Transformers.js InterruptableStoppingCriteria exists in 4.3.0); a single vision_encoder run() is not interruptible in practice on single-thread WASM

training_data.assessment: Mixed; SmolVLM2 video mixture includes academic-only / NC datasets. Weights are Apache-2.0; whether NC training data constrains commercial use is a legal question (flag). SmolVLM-500M-Instruct (image-only v1) has the smaller data footprint (Cauldron + Docmatix).

image_preprocessing.processor: SmolVLMImageProcessor: do_image_splitting=true, size.longest_edge=2048, max_image_size.longest_edge=512, mean/std 0.5, image_seq_len=64 per 512x512 tile (SigLIP 512/16 -> 1024 patches, pixel-shuffle scale_factor 4 -> 64)
image_preprocessing.tokens_per_image: 64 per tile; derived worst case square 2048 input = 4x4 tiles + 1 global = 17 x 64 = 1088 image tokens (computed from config, not measured); longest_edge=512 -> 64 tokens
image_preprocessing.litert_bundle: fixed single 512x512 image, 64 tokens, no splitting; normalisation baked into graph

onnx.onnx_community: no separate onnx-community SmolVLM repo needed; exports live in HuggingFaceTB repos

gguf.llama_cpp_support: listed in llama.cpp docs/multimodal.md (libmtmd) for SmolVLM 256M/500M and SmolVLM2 256M/500M

litert.quantization: vision encoder + connector int8; decoder int4 (blockwise-32); tied embedding int8; KV 2048

community_measurements_text_path_only.caveat: Card states the gate prompt carries no image; vision path latency/memory not measured. Manifest is internally inconsistent about GPU on S26.

candidates.mediapipe_llm_inference: NO for SmolVLM: MediaPipe LLM Inference API is maintenance-only; documented image input only for Gemma 3n; litert-community SmolVLM-256M card states VLMs not supported on MediaPipe LLM Inference

artifacts.note: 0.5B and 2B .mf.gz files uploaded 2024-12-05 (commits c22fc41f / 0394c52e for 0.5B int4 / int8); earlier .bin.gz uploads of 2024-12-03 were deleted. Branch README: license apache-2.0.
